scope: Root softening, no-softening controls, vowel loss, exploratory yok nominalizations, and doubled-consonant compounds
interpretation: All 57 initial examples outside the exploratory existential group preserved at center touches. This does not establish morphology completeness or offset robustness.
yokunuzdan → yolunuzdan is an exploratory uncommon nominalization, not counted as a confirmed everyday spelling failure.
sırrımdakiler → sırtımdakiler and zannımdakiler → sanımdakiler are new compound counterexamples; consonant doubling versus continuation cause not yet isolated.
Source roots sır/zan/hak/his/had have no alternation; ret has tToD. This is a clue, not sufficient causal proof.
validation: Two targeted export tests passed; no simulator run.
next_step: Trace sır/sırrı/sırrım/sırrımda/sırrımdakiler and zan equivalents, compare false replacements and explicitly doubled test roots.
